hunks.baseline: A gloomy underground gambling den. A middle-aged man sitting in a corner lowered his head.
hunks.sol: In a dank underground gambling den, a middle-aged man sat in a corner, fiddling with a set of bone tiles. His head drooped.

hunks.baseline: “……I’m done for.”
hunks.sol: “…I’m done for.”

hunks.baseline: A pair of glasses—an item imported from the Western Regions—rested on his nose. Until a few days ago, they would have easily cost dozens of silver nyang. But not anymore.
hunks.sol: A pair of glasses—an item imported from the Western Regions—rested on his nose. Until a few days ago, they would easily have been worth dozens of silver nyang.
Not anymore.

hunks.baseline: The lenses, which were said to magnify objects several times over, were cracked all over like a rice paddy in a drought.
hunks.sol: The lenses, said to magnify objects several times over, were cracked like rice paddies in a drought.

hunks.baseline: Two men were watching the middle-aged man from a distance.
hunks.sol: Two men watched him from a distance.

hunks.baseline: “Is that him? Is he really the one…?”
hunks.sol: “Is that him? Is he really…?”

hunks.baseline: The two men, one with narrow, birdlike eyes and the other with a goat’s beard, were ordinary gamblers of the sort one could find anywhere.
hunks.sol: One had narrow, birdlike eyes, while the other sported a goat’s beard. Otherwise, they were ordinary gamblers of the sort one could find anywhere.

hunks.baseline: As they watched Kwak Cheolyung deal the bone tiles again, the goat-bearded man asked, “But what happened to him?”
hunks.sol: As they watched Kwak Cheolyung shuffle the bone tiles again, the goat-bearded man asked, “But what happened to him?”

hunks.baseline: As his question suggested, Kwak Cheolyung was in a pitiful state.
hunks.sol: It was a fair question. Kwak Cheolyung looked dreadful.

hunks.baseline: His complexion was haggard, and his beard had gone untrimmed. His silk clothes were filthy black with grime and torn in several places.
hunks.sol: His face was haggard, and his beard had gone untrimmed. His silk clothes were black with grime and torn in several places.

hunks.baseline: They said he had spent his entire life roaming from one gambling table to another and amassed an enormous fortune.
hunks.sol: They said he had spent his entire life moving from one gambling table to another, amassing an enormous fortune along the way.

hunks.baseline: But now, he looked like nothing more or less than a gambler who had lost everything.
hunks.sol: Now, however, he looked like nothing more or less than a gambler who had lost everything.

hunks.baseline: “It did. Something very serious.”
hunks.sol: “It did. Something serious.”

hunks.baseline: The narrow-eyed man nodded. Unlike the goat-bearded man, who had arrived in Henan late, he knew exactly what had happened to Kwak Cheolyung recently.
hunks.sol: The narrow-eyed man nodded. Unlike the goat-bearded man, who had arrived late in Henan, he knew exactly what had happened to Kwak Cheolyung.

hunks.baseline: “He lost a gamble.”
hunks.sol: “He lost a bet.”

hunks.baseline: “They are. But what if it was a game worth a thousand silver nyang?”
hunks.sol: “They are. But what if a thousand silver nyang were at stake?”

hunks.baseline: That was enough money to live in luxury for the rest of one’s life—or even enough for three generations to live like kings.
hunks.sol: That was enough money for someone to live in luxury for the rest of his life—no, enough for three generations to live like kings.

hunks.baseline: He clicked his tongue regretfully, lamenting that he had never seen such a massive game, and asked, “It must have been the biggest wager since the founding of the country. Who was his opponent? A-Gwi? Or Jjak-Gwi?”
hunks.sol: Regretting that he had missed such a massive game, he smacked his lips and asked, “It must have been the biggest wager since the founding of the country. Who was his opponent? A-Gwi? Or Jjak-Gwi?”

hunks.baseline: “My friend, I knew you were hard of hearing, but you really are completely out of touch with recent news. A-Gwi had his wrist cut off by a fellow called the Qingcheng Mountain Guillotine a couple of months ago, and Jjak-Gwi disappeared a long time ago.”
hunks.sol: “My friend, I already knew you were hard of hearing, but you’re completely out of touch with recent news. A-Gwi had his wrist cut off by a fellow called the Mount Qingcheng Guillotine a couple of months ago, and Jjak-Gwi disappeared long ago.”

hunks.baseline: “Jin Taekyung of the Jin Family of Taiyuan. He’s the Fire King’s Disciple.”
hunks.sol: “Jin Taekyung of the Jin Family of Taiyuan. The Fire King’s disciple.”

hunks.baseline: The Fire King was one of the Ten Kings and a Supreme Peak master whose reputation resounded throughout the world. There was no reason for such a man’s Disciple to gamble with a Dogon.
hunks.sol: The Fire King was one of the Ten Kings and a Supreme Peak master whose reputation resounded throughout the world. There was no reason for such a man’s disciple to gamble with a Dogon.

hunks.baseline: The goat-bearded man thought for a moment before crying out as if in a groan.
hunks.sol: After thinking for a moment, the goat-bearded man cried out.

hunks.baseline: The Star-Array Grand Banquet’s betting games were considered the greatest gambling matches held anywhere under heaven, and were therefore called Dodo.
hunks.sol: The Star-Array Grand Banquet’s betting games were considered the greatest gambling matches anywhere under heaven, and were therefore called Dodo.

hunks.baseline: “Tsk, tsk. Kwak Cheolyung did something stupid. The odds on the preliminaries may have been high, but he should have considered that meant they were dangerous, too.”
hunks.sol: “Tsk, tsk. Kwak Cheolyung did something stupid. The odds on the preliminaries may have been high, but he should have realized that meant the risk was high, too.”

hunks.baseline: “Do you think he bet without thinking? He must have been confident for his own reasons.”
hunks.sol: “Do you think he bet without thinking? He must have had his reasons for being confident.”

hunks.baseline: “What did he bet on, and against whom?”
hunks.sol: “What did he bet on?”

hunks.baseline: “I suppose he’s strong, since he’s the Seafaring King’s Disciple, but I don’t think he’s quite that good.”
hunks.sol: “I suppose he’s strong, being the Seafaring King’s disciple, but I don’t think he’s quite that good.”

hunks.baseline: “He seems to have gained some insight recently. I heard one-tenth of a cliff was blown away by the Iron-Water Divine Dragon’s Ship-Breaking Fist.”
hunks.sol: “He seems to have gained some insight recently. I heard the Iron-Water Divine Dragon blew away a tenth of a cliff with his Ship-Breaking Fist.”

hunks.baseline: “……Is that even possible?”
hunks.sol: “…Is that even possible?”

hunks.baseline: He had heard rumors of Murim masters breaking apart the earth and cleaving the sky, but he had never imagined it could be to this extent.
hunks.sol: The goat-bearded man had heard tales of Murim masters shattering the earth and cleaving the sky, but he had never imagined they were capable of anything like that.

hunks.baseline: Just as the goat-bearded man was struggling to contain his astonishment, another unbelievable statement followed.
hunks.sol: While he was still reeling in astonishment, the narrow-eyed man said something even harder to believe.

hunks.baseline: “What’s so impossible about it? Immediately afterward, the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi even brought the cliff down.”
hunks.sol: “What’s so impossible about it? Right afterward, the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi brought down the entire cliff.”

hunks.baseline: The goat-bearded man asked haltingly, his eyes as wide as plates.
hunks.sol: The goat-bearded man’s eyes grew as wide as plates.

hunks.baseline: “Y-You mean he collapsed a cliff?”
hunks.sol: “H-He brought down a cliff?”

hunks.baseline: “That’s right. According to the witnesses, it came down with an enormous roar.”
hunks.sol: “That’s right. According to the witnesses, the whole thing came crashing down.”

hunks.baseline: The goat-bearded man did not answer. Instead, he stared at his friend with distrustful eyes.
hunks.sol: The goat-bearded man said nothing. He merely stared at his friend in disbelief.

hunks.baseline: “Everyone else, myself included, dismissed it as a wild rumor at first. A person made of flesh and blood bringing down a cliff with his bare hands—it didn’t seem possible.”
hunks.sol: “Everyone else, myself included, dismissed it as one at first. A man of flesh and blood bringing down a cliff with his bare hands? It didn’t seem possible.”

hunks.baseline: “What do you think it feels like to lose money in a game you were certain you’d win?”
hunks.sol: “What do you think happens when someone loses money on a bet he was certain he’d win?”

hunks.baseline: “Is Kwak Cheolyung any different? In the end, he’s just as crazy about gambling as anyone else.”
hunks.sol: “Is Kwak Cheolyung any different from the rest of us? In the end, he’s just as addicted to gambling.”

hunks.baseline: “On that day three days ago, when the Iron-Water Divine Dragon gave up on the Star-Array Grand Banquet and returned to the Yangtze, Kwak Cheolyung completely lost his mind.”
hunks.sol: “Three days ago, when the Iron-Water Divine Dragon withdrew from the Star-Array Grand Banquet and returned to the Yangtze, Kwak Cheolyung completely lost his mind.”

hunks.baseline: “That Supreme Peak master who was said to have no equal in kicks throughout Guangxi?”
hunks.sol: “That Peak master said to have no equal in kicks throughout Guangxi?”

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: “Yes. Though by now, he probably has quite a few equals. One of his legs was broken.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. Though by now, he probably has plenty of equals. One of his legs is broken.”

hunks.baseline: “Don’t tell me that was the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi, too?”
hunks.sol: “Don’t tell me the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi did that, too.”

hunks.baseline: “Are you starting to understand? That’s right. The two of them got into a minor dispute and agreed to exchange one clean blow each before calling it even. But one kick from the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi supposedly broke Jong Sam’s shin.”
hunks.sol: “Starting to see the pattern? That’s right. The two of them got into a minor dispute and agreed to exchange one clean blow each, then call it even. But a single kick from the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi broke Jong Sam’s shin.”

hunks.baseline: “I don’t know. They say he gave it a casual kick, and the shin snapped with a crunch.”
hunks.sol: “I don’t know. They say he gave it a light kick, and the bone snapped with a crunch.”

hunks.baseline: “And even though the Hunroe Leg struck first, the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi apparently only scratched his calf a few times before finishing the fight. After that, there was probably…”
hunks.sol: “The Hunroe Leg even struck first, but the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi just scratched his calf a few times afterward, and that was it. And next was probably…”

hunks.baseline: The stories that continued to pour from the narrow-eyed man’s mouth about the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi were nothing short of shocking.
hunks.sol: The stories that continued pouring from the narrow-eyed man’s mouth were nothing short of shocking.

hunks.baseline: The Kunlun Sect’s Kunlun Cloud Dragon, said to have the finest lightness technique among all the young prodigies under heaven, leaped five jang straight up from a standing position—only to fall with Jin Taekyung’s foot planted on his face.
hunks.sol: The Kunlun Sect’s Kunlun Cloud Dragon, said to possess the finest lightness technique among all the young prodigies under heaven, leaped five jang from a standing position—only to come crashing down with Jin Taekyung’s foot planted on his face.

hunks.baseline: The Beggars’ Sect’s Successor Beggar became furious when he could not close the gap between himself and Jin Taekyung during the movement-technique assessment. Unable to contain his anger, he grabbed Taekyung by the back of the neck and was beaten like a dog.
hunks.sol: The Beggars’ Sect’s Successor Beggar flew into a rage when he could not close the distance between himself and Jin Taekyung during the movement-technique assessment. Unable to contain his anger, he grabbed Taekyung by the back of the neck and was promptly beaten like a dog.

hunks.baseline: “The fifth assessment was mechanisms and formations. Everyone believed that this time, the Zhuge Clan’s Lesser Family Head would take first place, but…”
hunks.sol: “The fifth assessment was mechanisms and formations. This time, everyone was certain the Zhuge Clan’s Lesser Family Head would take first place, but…”

hunks.baseline: “You got it right.”
hunks.sol: “Exactly.”

hunks.baseline: “But seriously, how? What kind of freak is he to be proficient in mechanisms and formations, too?”
hunks.sol: “But seriously, how? What kind of freak is proficient in mechanisms and formations, too?”

hunks.baseline: “No. He’s just proficient in martial arts. Since the ignorant bastard didn’t know what anything was, he simply smashed his way through everything and passed.”
hunks.sol: “He isn’t. He’s just proficient in martial arts. The ignorant bastard had no idea what anything was, so he smashed everything in his path and forced his way through.”

hunks.baseline: “Anyway, the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi took first place in the preliminaries, and Kwak Cheolyung, who bet on someone different every time, was left completely penniless. I heard he sank all the money he’d earned into it, then even mortgaged the estate and land where he’d planned to retire to borrow from loan sharks… Tsk, tsk.”
hunks.sol: “Anyway, the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi took first place in the preliminaries, and Kwak Cheolyung, who bet on someone different every time, was left penniless. I heard he lost everything he’d ever earned, then mortgaged the estate and land where he’d planned to retire so he could borrow from loan sharks… Tsk, tsk.”

hunks.baseline: The narrow-eyed man looked at Kwak Cheolyung with sympathy.
hunks.sol: The narrow-eyed man gazed at Kwak Cheolyung with sympathy.

hunks.baseline: In front of the legendary Dogon, who had once amassed a tremendous fortune, only a few silver nyang remained. And those were probably his entire fortune.
hunks.sol: Only a few silver nyang sat before the legendary Dogon who had once amassed a tremendous fortune. They were probably all he had left in the world.

hunks.baseline: “Whether you earn it or lose it, it all happens in one shot. Isn’t that right?”
hunks.sol: “Whether you make a fortune or lose one, it all happens in a single stroke. Isn’t that right?”

hunks.baseline: Only then did the goat-bearded man come to his senses and lick his parched lips.
hunks.sol: Only then did the goat-bearded man come to his senses. He licked his parched lips.

hunks.baseline: “He really struck it rich. Why else would they call him the Gold-Faced Young Master?”
hunks.sol: “He certainly struck it rich. Why else would they call him the Gold-Faced Young Master?”

hunks.baseline: “He has incredible foresight. He must have won tens of thousands of silver nyang in this Dodo alone. Why else would he go around wearing a mask made of gold?”
hunks.sol: “He has incredible foresight. He must have won tens of thousands of silver nyang from this Dodo alone. Why else would he go around wearing a mask made of gold?”

hunks.baseline: “They say he’s still a young man who hasn’t even turned thirty… I suppose people who are destined for greatness really are destined for greatness.”
hunks.sol: “They say he hasn’t even turned thirty yet… I suppose some men are simply destined to succeed.”

hunks.baseline: “Damn it. Some of us don’t even have a proper house at this age. Hoo…”
hunks.sol: “Damn it. Some of us have reached this age without even owning a proper house. Hoo…”

hunks.baseline: The two men let out a deep sigh.
hunks.sol: The two men let out deep sighs.

hunks.baseline: At that moment, someone stood up with the sound of a chair scraping across the floor.
hunks.sol: Then a chair scraped across the floor as someone rose to his feet.

hunks.baseline: Kwak Cheolyung staggered out of the gambling den. The only thing in his hand was a few iron coins he had been given as a consolation handout.
hunks.sol: Kwak Cheolyung staggered out of the gambling den. All he held were a few iron coins he had received as a consolation handout.

hunks.baseline: The Star-Array Grand Banquet was a long race that lasted at least half a month and, at most, a month.
hunks.sol: The Star-Array Grand Banquet was a long race, lasting at least half a month and sometimes as long as a full month.

hunks.baseline: Once the three-day preliminary assessments ended, the applicants were given one day of free time. That applied to me, too.
hunks.sol: After the three-day preliminary assessments ended, the applicants were given a day of free time.
That included me.

hunks.baseline: “Ahem. Ahem!”
hunks.sol: “Ahem. Ahehem!”

hunks.baseline: “Captain! Captain!”
hunks.sol: “Captain! Captaiiin!”

hunks.baseline: “……Oh, please.”
hunks.sol: “…Oh, please.”

hunks.baseline: *Don’t. Don’t shout in a place this crowded. I’m already dying from all the attention, and now you’re making everyone stare even more.*
hunks.sol: *Don’t. Don’t shout in a place this crowded. I’m already dying from all the attention, and now you’re making even more people stare.*

hunks.baseline: I hurried toward the group as quickly as I could.
hunks.sol: I hurried toward my companions as quickly as I could.

hunks.baseline: As if he had been waiting for me, Jin Wikyung’s bear-like bulk came charging forward with his arms spread wide.
hunks.sol: As though he had been waiting for me, Jin Wikyung’s bear-like bulk charged forward with both arms spread wide.

hunks.baseline: The moment his bear paw locked around my upper body, Hyuk Mujin grabbed the back of my hand and rubbed his cheek against it.
hunks.sol: The moment his bear paw locked around my upper body, Hyuk Mujin seized the back of my hand and rubbed his cheek against it.

hunks.baseline: “Ohhh, Captain! First place in the Star-Array Grand Banquet! The pride of the Jin Family of Taiyuan! The beacon of Shanxi Province! Our Captain! My lord!”
hunks.sol: “Ohhh, Captain! Top scorer in the Star-Array Grand Banquet preliminaries! The pride of the Jin Family of Taiyuan! The beacon of Shanxi Province! Our Captain! My lord!”

hunks.baseline: *Jin Wikyung is my brother, so I’ll let it slide. But what the hell is wrong with Hyuk Mujin?*
hunks.sol: *Wikyung is one thing, but what the hell is wrong with Hyuk Mujin?*

hunks.sol: Doing my best to hide my bewilderment, I asked, “Are you out of your mind?”

hunks.baseline: “Yes. I’m insane! I’ve gone insane over your strength!”
hunks.sol: “Yes. I’m insane! Your strength has driven me mad!”

hunks.baseline: “Are you seriously crazy? Let go. Aren’t you going to let go?”
hunks.sol: “Are you seriously crazy? Let go. Let go already!”

hunks.baseline: Even after I struck him three times on the crown of his head at lightning speed, Hyuk Mujin did not budge.
hunks.sol: Even after I struck the crown of his head three times at lightning speed, Hyuk Mujin refused to budge.

hunks.baseline: Tears welled up in his eyes from the pain, but he refused to let go of my hand.
hunks.sol: Tears welled in his eyes from the pain, but he still would not release my hand.

hunks.baseline: “……Are you into that kind of thing?”
hunks.sol: “…Are you into that kind of thing?”

hunks.baseline: I had only heard about it. That there were people who felt pleasure from being hit.
hunks.sol: I had only heard rumors about people who took pleasure in being hit.

hunks.baseline: I had wondered why he had not left even after being hit by me countless times. But now that I considered the possibility that he was one of those people, a chill ran down my spine.
hunks.sol: I had always wondered why he had never left despite the countless beatings I had given him. Now that I considered the possibility that he was one of those people, a chill ran down my spine.

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin, struck precisely in the temple, collapsed onto the ground.
hunks.sol: The blow landed squarely on Hyuk Mujin’s temple, and he collapsed to the ground.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, something that glinted brightly slipped from inside his robes and landed on the floor.
hunks.sol: At the same time, something bright and glittering slipped from inside his robes and landed on the floor.

hunks.baseline: *What is this now?*
hunks.sol: *What the hell is this?*

hunks.baseline: *Is it a prop used for that kind of play?*
hunks.sol: *Is it a prop for that kind of play?*

hunks.baseline: With a serious expression, I tucked the mask into my robes.
hunks.sol: With a grave expression, I tucked the mask into my robes.

hunks.baseline: *That dangerous bastard Hyuk Mujin. This mask is confiscated for life.*
hunks.sol: *Hyuk Mujin, you dangerous bastard. This mask is confiscated for life.*

hunks.baseline: *Not a chance.*
hunks.sol: *Not on my watch.*

hunks.baseline: “Ahem. Cough, cough!”
hunks.sol: “Ahem. Ahehem!”

hunks.baseline: “Do you have a throat problem?”
hunks.sol: “Do you have bronchitis?”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang, who had been staring at a distant mountain and repeatedly clearing his throat, flinched.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang, who had been staring off at a distant mountain and repeatedly clearing his throat, flinched.

hunks.baseline: “W-What nonsense are you talking about?”
hunks.sol: “W-What nonsense are you spouting?”

hunks.baseline: Watching Jeok Cheongang act distractedly, as though he wanted to say something but could not bring himself to do it, made the corners of my mouth rise on their own.
hunks.sol: He kept looking away, clearly wanting to say something but pretending otherwise. The corners of my mouth rose on their own.

hunks.baseline: “Ahem. Don’t get so pleased with yourself over something so minor. Anyone could do it, so don’t make a fuss.”
hunks.sol: “Ahem. Don’t get so pleased with yourself over something so trivial. Anyone could have done it, so stop making a fuss.”

hunks.baseline: “It’s only the preliminaries. Have you forgotten what this old man told you? The world is vast, and there are many masters.”
hunks.sol: “These were merely the preliminaries. Have you forgotten what this old man told you? The world is vast, and there are many masters.”

hunks.baseline: Their backgrounds and specialties were all different, but the five of them now shared one thing in common.
hunks.sol: Their backgrounds and specialties were all different, but the five of them now had one thing in common.

hunks.baseline: “I beat them all.”
hunks.sol: “I beat every last one of them.”

hunks.baseline: For a moment, Jeok Cheongang was at a loss for words. Then he shook his head again and again.
hunks.sol: For a moment, Jeok Cheongang was at a loss for words. Then he shook his head.

hunks.baseline: “Pathetic weaklings.”
hunks.sol: “Bah. Pathetic weaklings.”

hunks.baseline: “Could you just tell me I did well? I raised your honor—Old Master, no, Master—and the name of the Fire Gate Clan.”
hunks.sol: “Could you just tell me I did well? I brought honor to you—Old Master, no, Master—and to the Fire Gate Clan.”

hunks.baseline: He spoke sternly, but the corners of his mouth were twitching.
hunks.sol: His words were stern, but the corners of his mouth were twitching.

hunks.baseline: It was obvious that he was barely holding back laughter.
hunks.sol: He was obviously struggling to hold back a smile.

hunks.baseline: Even if I had not heard the Sound Transmission that Jin Wikyung sent me the next moment, I could have guessed as much.

hunks.baseline: “Do not get cocky just because you defeated a few nobodies. Compose your body and mind and prepare for the main event. Understood?”

He was right.

hunks.sol: *The world really is vast. He was right about that.*

hunks.sol: Anyone who had concealed their true ability during the preliminaries was not only strong, but clever.

hunks.baseline: “I’ll keep it in mind, Master.”
hunks.sol: “I’ll keep that in mind, Master.”

hunks.sol: An unmistakable smile appeared at the wrinkled corners of Jeok Cheongang’s mouth.
